thresholds.source: Project-defined PM7 heat-of-formation surrogate fidelity bands; 1 kcal/mol is used only as a stringent engineering reference, not as absolute chemical accuracy.
thresholds.rationale: Molecular PM7 target MAE is the core metric; per-atom errors remain diagnostic.

thresholds.source: Project-defined stored-MOPAC-net-charge reproduction bands, frozen before v3 architecture comparison.
thresholds.rationale: Atom-level MAE measures fidelity to the NET ATOMIC CHARGES parsed by the data generator; the generator does not request MULLIK, so these must not be mislabeled as Mulliken charges. Charge-sum error is diagnostic only.

thresholds.source: Project-defined pair-distance reconstruction bands based on the project's Angstrom coordinate target; 2 Angstrom is a reporting stratum, not a claim about the all-pairs training loss.
thresholds.rationale: The worst of bonded and <=2 Angstrom local-nonbonded pair MAE is the gate so numerous long-range pairs cannot dilute local geometry failures.
Macro-F1 prevents H/C/O frequency from dominating the gate.
F1, rather than BCE, directly checks positive-bond recovery under sampled negatives.
Macro-F1 protects double/triple/aromatic classes from single-bond dominance.
Every descriptor is also reported in its own raw space; normalized aggregation is only a scale-comparable gate.
Regression normalized MAE and classification error are combined conservatively by their worst group.
The worst descriptor group prevents frequent binary labels from hiding weak multiclass descriptors.
